description: Decision-equality corpus for operation authorization phase 1. Each case is a global policy, optional Agent-local layers and one request (or a timer creation-target probe). expected is what the existing evaluator decides: the combined decision, each layer's decision, deciding rule and secret part, and the approval options of an ask. Checked by OperationAttributionTests at the base and at the phase-1 revision.

cases.name: correlated delivery to the same Session is allowed
cases.global:
version: 1
defaultAction: deny
rules:
- id: deliver-self
  tool: {source: builtin, name: send_file}
  node: box
  args: {sessionId: {session: {self: true}}}
  action: allow

cases.name: correlated delivery to another Session is denied
cases.global:
version: 1
defaultAction: deny
rules:
- id: deliver-self
  tool: {source: builtin, name: send_file}
  node: box
  args: {sessionId: {session: {self: true}}}
  action: allow

cases.name: conditional ask for a safe command
conditional ask denies other commands
single-name secret allow, first name
single-name secret allow, second name
two single-name secret allows deny the pair
ordinary exec allow with an unowned secret is denied
cases.global:
version: 1
defaultAction: allow
rules:
- id: ls-only
  tool: {source: node, name: exec}
  args: {command: ls}
  action: allow
- id: deny-rest
  action: deny

cases.name: ordinary exec allow with an owned secret is allowed
cases.global:
version: 1
defaultAction: allow
rules:
- id: ls-only
  tool: {source: node, name: exec}
  args: {command: ls}
  action: allow
- id: deny-rest
  action: deny

version: 1
